services.title: Organizational services
services.intro: A service is a controlled connection to an org system (ops DB, accounting, …). Credentials stay server-side; granted users' assistants reach it only through the gateway, capped at their access level.
services.name: Service name
services.descriptionHint: Helps the assistant understand what data this service holds; be precise.
services.connReadHint: A DB account with SELECT-only grants. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
services.connRotateHint: Enter a new value to rotate; leave empty to keep.
services.connWriteHint: Unused until the change-approval flow ships.
services.noGrants: No users granted yet — without a grant, users cannot see this service at all.
services.deleteConfirmBody: Delete “{{name}}” with all its grants and call history? This cannot be undone.
